rationale: This is an extremely low float ($0.56M shares) micro-cap with a massive 257 bps bid-ask spread, making entry and exit costs prohibitive for intraday trading. The stock opened at $5.40, ran to $5.96, then collapsed to $3.97 before recovering to $4.67 — it is now trading well below both the session VWAP ($5.71) and 5-min VWAP ($5.10), indicating sustained selling pressure, but the extreme intraday range and illiquidity make directional conviction unreliable. With no news catalyst, no historical comparable setups, and a spread that would immediately consume a significant portion of any expected move, the risk/reward does not justify entry in either direction.
